# Genesis

בראשית

Link: [https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis)

בריאת העולם, תחילתה של האנושות וסיפורי האבות והאמהות.

Creation, the beginning of mankind, and stories of the patriarchs and matriarchs.

Sections: Chapter-Verse

Location: Tanakh/Torah

Originally from [Sefaria](https://www.sefaria.org) via [TorahLM.org](https://torahlm.org) — see [licensing](https://torahlm.org/sefaria_license).

Version (He): Miqra according to the Masorah (Segments: 1533, License: CC-BY-SA)

Versions (En):
  - Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009 (Segments: 1533, License: CC-BY)
  - The Koren Jerusalem Bible (Segments: 1533, License: CC-BY-NC)
  - The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein (Segments: 1533, License: CC-BY)


## Chapter 1

###### Genesis 1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:1)


בְּרֵאשִׁ֖ית בָּרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֵ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
In the beginning Elohim created the heavens and the earth.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
IN THE BEGINNING God created the heaven and the earth.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
In the beginning of the creation by G-d [Elokim, the attribute of justice,] of the heavens and the earth, [G-d first intending to create the world with the attribute of justice but then granting precedence to the attribute of mercy (Yod-Key-Vav-Key), seeing that the world could not otherwise endure],


###### Genesis 1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:2)


וְהָאָ֗רֶץ הָיְתָ֥ה תֹ֙הוּ֙ וָבֹ֔הוּ וְחֹ֖שֶׁךְ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י תְה֑וֹם וְר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מְרַחֶ֖פֶת עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַמָּֽיִם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The earth was unformed and desolate, and (there was) darkness over the surface of the abyss. The breath of Elohim hovered above the surface of the water.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the earth was without form and void; and darkness was on the face of the deep. And a wind from God moved over the surface of the waters.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
the earth was vacuous and void, and there was darkness upon the face of the deep [i.e., the waters], and the "wind of G-d" [the Throne of Glory, impelled by His utterance] hovered over the face of the waters.


###### Genesis 1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:3)


וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֖ים יְהִ֣י א֑וֹר וַֽיְהִי־אֽוֹר׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elohim said, Let there be light. and there was light.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d said: Let there be light! And there was light.


###### Genesis 1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:4)


וַיַּ֧רְא אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־הָא֖וֹר כִּי־ט֑וֹב וַיַּבְדֵּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֔ים בֵּ֥ין הָא֖וֹר וּבֵ֥ין הַחֹֽשֶׁךְ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elohim saw that the light was good, and Elohim divided the light from the darkness.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d saw that the light was good, [and that it was not appropriate for light and darkness to serve in combination] and G-d separated between the light and the darkness, [making the day the domain of the first and the night the domain of the second].


###### Genesis 1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:5)


וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀לָאוֹר֙ י֔וֹם וְלַחֹ֖שֶׁךְ קָ֣רָא לָ֑יְלָה וַֽיְהִי־עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃{פ}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elohim called the light day, and the darkness He called night. It became evening and it became morning, one day.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And God called the light Day, and the darkness He called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, one day.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d called the light day, and the darkness He called night. And it was evening and it was morning, the day of the One, [the angels not being created until the second day].


###### Genesis 1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:6)


וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים יְהִ֥י רָקִ֖יעַ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַמָּ֑יִם וִיהִ֣י מַבְדִּ֔יל בֵּ֥ין מַ֖יִם לָמָֽיִם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elohim said, Let there be a canopy in the midst of the waters, and let it divide between waters and waters.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide water from water.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d said: Let there be a firmament [i.e., let the firmament be hardened] in the midst of the waters, [the upper waters being at a distance from the firmament just as the lower waters are], and let it divide between waters and waters.


###### Genesis 1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:7)


וַיַּ֣עַשׂ אֱלֹהִים֮ אֶת־הָרָקִ֒יעַ֒ וַיַּבְדֵּ֗ל בֵּ֤ין הַמַּ֙יִם֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ מִתַּ֣חַת לָרָקִ֔יעַ וּבֵ֣ין הַמַּ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵעַ֣ל לָרָקִ֑יעַ וַֽיְהִי־כֵֽן׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elohim made the canopy, and divided the waters which were beneath the canopy, from the waters which were above the canopy, and it was so.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d made [i.e., fixed in place] the firmament, and He divided between the waters below the firmament and the waters above the firmament; and it was so.


###### Genesis 1:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:8)


וַיִּקְרָ֧א אֱלֹהִ֛ים לָֽרָקִ֖יעַ שָׁמָ֑יִם וַֽיְהִי־עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם שֵׁנִֽי׃{פ}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elohim called the canopy heaven. It became evening and it became morning the second day.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And God called the firmament Heaven. And there was evening and there was morning, a second day.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d called the firmament shamayim [sa mayim - it "carries" water (the upper waters); sham mayim - water is there; esh umayim - fire and water (the firmament being a combination of the two)]. And it was evening, and it was morning, the second day.


###### Genesis 1:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:9)


וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִקָּו֨וּ הַמַּ֜יִם מִתַּ֤חַת הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ אֶל־מָק֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד וְתֵרָאֶ֖ה הַיַּבָּשָׁ֑ה וַֽיְהִי־כֵֽן׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elohim said, Let the waters beneath the heavens be gathered into one place, and let the dryness be seen. It was so.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d said: Let the waters below the heavens, [which were spread over the entire earth], be gathered into one place [the ocean], and let the dry land be seen; and it was so.


###### Genesis 1:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:10)


וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀לַיַּבָּשָׁה֙ אֶ֔רֶץ וּלְמִקְוֵ֥ה הַמַּ֖יִם קָרָ֣א יַמִּ֑ים וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־טֽוֹב׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elohim called the dryness, earth, and the gathering of the waters, He called seas, and Elohim saw that it was good.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters He called Seas: and God saw that it was good.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d called the dry land "earth," and the gathering of the waters He called "seas" [(plural, fish from different regions of the sea having distinctive tastes)], and G-d saw that it was good, [the "work of the waters" being completed on that day].


###### Genesis 1:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:11)


וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים תַּֽדְשֵׁ֤א הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ דֶּ֗שֶׁא עֵ֚שֶׂב מַזְרִ֣יעַ זֶ֔רַע עֵ֣ץ פְּרִ֞י עֹ֤שֶׂה פְּרִי֙ לְמִינ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר זַרְעוֹ־ב֖וֹ עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיְהִי־כֵֽן׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elohim said, Let the earth sprout grass, seed-yielding herbs, fruit trees bearing fruit of its own kind, with its seed within it, upon the earth. And it was so.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, herb yielding seed, and fruit tree yielding fruit after its kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d said: Let the earth put forth [a blanket of] herbage, grass yielding seed, fruit-tree, [the tree tasting like the fruit], giving fruit of its kind, whose seed is in it [to grow a tree of the same kind] upon the earth; and it was so.


###### Genesis 1:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:12)


וַתּוֹצֵ֨א הָאָ֜רֶץ דֶּ֠שֶׁא עֵ֣שֶׂב מַזְרִ֤יעַ זֶ֙רַע֙ לְמִינֵ֔הוּ וְעֵ֧ץ עֹֽשֶׂה־פְּרִ֛י אֲשֶׁ֥ר זַרְעוֹ־ב֖וֹ לְמִינֵ֑הוּ וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־טֽוֹב׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The earth brought forth grass, herbs yielding seed of its kind, and trees bearing fruit which has in it seeds of its kind; and Elohim saw that it was good.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the earth brought forth grass, herb yielding seed after its kind, and tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after its kind: and God saw that it was good.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the earth put forth herbage, grass yielding seed according to its kind [though not having been commanded to do so], and tree giving fruit [(but not "fruit-tree" as commanded (11), for which the earth was subsequently punished, together with Adam)], whose seed is in it according to its kind. And G-d saw that it was good.


###### Genesis 1:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:13)


וַֽיְהִי־עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם שְׁלִישִֽׁי׃{פ}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
It became evening and it became morning, the third day.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And there was evening and there was morning, a third day.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And it was evening, and it was morning, the third day.


###### Genesis 1:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:14)


וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים יְהִ֤י מְאֹרֹת֙ בִּרְקִ֣יעַ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם לְהַבְדִּ֕יל בֵּ֥ין הַיּ֖וֹם וּבֵ֣ין הַלָּ֑יְלָה וְהָי֤וּ לְאֹתֹת֙ וּלְמ֣וֹעֲדִ֔ים וּלְיָמִ֖ים וְשָׁנִֽים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elohim said, Let there be lights in the canopy of heaven to divide between the day and the night, and they will serve for signs for seasons, (for) days and (for) years.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d said: Let there be [suspended] luminaries in the firmament of the heaven [(The luminaries, like all things pertaining to heaven and to earth, had been created on the first day, but each of the particular creations was activated on its particular day.)] to divide between the day and the night, [after the first light had been secreted for the righteous for the world to come.] And let them serve for signs [(eclipses being omens of ill)], and for festivals, [reckoned by the New Moon], and for days, [the sun and the moon serving for half a day respectively], and for years, [completing their course through the zodiac in 365 days].


###### Genesis 1:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:15)


וְהָי֤וּ לִמְאוֹרֹת֙ בִּרְקִ֣יעַ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם לְהָאִ֖יר עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיְהִי־כֵֽן׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
They will be for lights in the canopy of heaven to illuminate the earth. And it was so.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and let them be for lights in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And let them [in addition] be luminaries in the firmament of the heaven to illuminate the earth; and it was so.


###### Genesis 1:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:16)


וַיַּ֣עַשׂ אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת־שְׁנֵ֥י הַמְּאֹרֹ֖ת הַגְּדֹלִ֑ים אֶת־הַמָּא֤וֹר הַגָּדֹל֙ לְמֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת הַיּ֔וֹם וְאֶת־הַמָּא֤וֹר הַקָּטֹן֙ לְמֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת הַלַּ֔יְלָה וְאֵ֖ת הַכּוֹכָבִֽים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elohim made the two great lights, the large light to rule the day, and the small light to rule the night, and the stars


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And God made the two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: and the stars also.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d made the two great luminaries [(They were created of equal size, but when the moon protested "two kings reigning with one crown," it was diminished)], the great luminary for governance of the day, and the small luminary for governance of the night, and the stars, [(G-d multiplying the moon's hosts to "appease" it for its diminution)].


###### Genesis 1:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:17)


וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בִּרְקִ֣יעַ הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם לְהָאִ֖יר עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elohim set them in the canopy of the heaven to illuminate the earth,


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And God set them in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth,


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth.


###### Genesis 1:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:18)


וְלִמְשֹׁל֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם וּבַלַּ֔יְלָה וּֽלְהַבְדִּ֔יל בֵּ֥ין הָא֖וֹר וּבֵ֣ין הַחֹ֑שֶׁךְ וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־טֽוֹב׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
to rule in the day and the night, and to divide between the light and the darkness; and Elohim saw that it was good.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And to rule by day and by night, and to divide between the light and the darkness. And G-d saw that it was good.


###### Genesis 1:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:19)


וַֽיְהִי־עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם רְבִיעִֽי׃{פ}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
It became evening and it became morning, the fourth day.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And there was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And it was evening, and it was morning, the fourth day.


###### Genesis 1:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:20)


וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים יִשְׁרְצ֣וּ הַמַּ֔יִם שֶׁ֖רֶץ נֶ֣פֶשׁ חַיָּ֑ה וְעוֹף֙ יְעוֹפֵ֣ף עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ עַל־פְּנֵ֖י רְקִ֥יעַ הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elohim said, Let the waters teem with swarms of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth, in the open canopy of the heaven.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And God said, Let the waters swarm abundantly with moving creatures that have life, and let birds fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d said: Let the waters swarm a swarming (sheretz) [creatures not higher than the ground (e.g., flies, worms, rodents, fish)] infused with life, and birds flying above the earth on the face of the firmament of heaven.


###### Genesis 1:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:21)


וַיִּבְרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת־הַתַּנִּינִ֖ם הַגְּדֹלִ֑ים וְאֵ֣ת כׇּל־נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַֽחַיָּ֣ה׀הָֽרֹמֶ֡שֶׂת אֲשֶׁר֩ שָׁרְצ֨וּ הַמַּ֜יִם לְמִֽינֵהֶ֗ם וְאֵ֨ת כׇּל־ע֤וֹף כָּנָף֙ לְמִינֵ֔הוּ וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־טֽוֹב׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
And thus Elohim created the great whales, and every living creature that creeps, with which the waters teem, of its kind, and every winged bird of its kind; and Elohim saw that it was good.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And God created the great crocodiles, and every living creature that moves, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind: and God saw that it was good.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d created the leviathans and all the creeping life-infused creatures, swarmed by the waters according to their kinds, and every winged bird according to its kind, and G-d saw that it was good.


###### Genesis 1:22

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elohim blessed them saying, Be fruitful and multiply, fill the waters of the seas, and let the birds multiply on the earth.

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

It became evening and it became morning, the fifth day.

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Genesis 1:25

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d said: Let us make man [(G-d in His humility "asking leave" of the angels)] in our image according to our likeness [to understand and to know], and yirdu [connoting "they shall have dominion over" (if they are virtuous) or (if they are not), "they shall be humbled before"] the fish of the sea, the birds of the heaven, the beasts, and all the earth, and all the creeping things that creep on the earth.

And thus Elohim created man in his image. In the form of Elohim, He created him, male and female, He created them.

And G-d created the man in his mould [that He had cast for him (Adam, as opposed to the other creations, being created by "hand" and not by pronouncement)]; in the image of G-d He created him; male and female He created them [on the sixth day, forming Eve from Adam's side].


###### Genesis 1:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/1:28)


וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֹתָם֮ אֱלֹהִים֒ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לָהֶ֜ם אֱלֹהִ֗ים פְּר֥וּ וּרְב֛וּ וּמִלְא֥וּ אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ וְכִבְשֻׁ֑הָ וּרְד֞וּ בִּדְגַ֤ת הַיָּם֙ וּבְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וּבְכׇל־חַיָּ֖ה הָֽרֹמֶ֥שֶׂת עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elohim blessed them, and Elohim said to them, Be fruitful and multiply, fill the earth and subdue it, and dominate the fish of the sea, the birds of the heaven, and every living thing that moves upon the earth.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And God blessed them, and God said to them, Be fruitful, and multiply, replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the air, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d blessed them, and G-d said to them: Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth and subdue it [(also readable as "subdue her," connoting both that the mitzvah of procreation is his and not hers, and that he is to keep her from being "free" with herself)], and have dominion over the fish of the sea and the birds of the heaven, and over all the animals that range the earth.

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**

And G-d said: Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed upon the face of the earth and every tree which has in it fruit of a tree, bearing seed. To you shall it be for food, [man not being permitted to kill animals for food until after the flood].

## Chapter 2

###### Genesis 2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:1)


וַיְכֻלּ֛וּ הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ וְכׇל־צְבָאָֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The heavens and the earth were completed, and [so were] all their conglomerations.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all their host.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the heavens and the earth were finished, and all of their hosts.


###### Genesis 2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:2)


וַיְכַ֤ל אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַיִּשְׁבֹּת֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִכׇּל־מְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elohim completed by the seventh day His work which He had made, and He abstained on the seventh day from all His work which He had made.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And by the seventh day God ended His work which He had done; and He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had done.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d completed on [i.e., precisely upon the advent of] the seventh day His work that He had done, and He rested on the seventh day, from all the work that He had done.


###### Genesis 2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:3)


וַיְבָ֤רֶךְ אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־י֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וַיְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֹת֑וֹ כִּ֣י ב֤וֹ שָׁבַת֙ מִכׇּל־מְלַאכְתּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁר־בָּרָ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃{פ}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elohim blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, for on it He abstained from all His work, which Elohim had created to do.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because in it He rested from all his work which God had created and performed.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And G-d blessed the seventh day [through the manna (a presage of the future), double the normal amount being provided on the sixth day], and He sanctified it, [through the manna, none falling on the Sabbath], for on it He rested from all of His work which the L-rd had created to do. [i.e., What was to have been done on the Sabbath was done on the sixth day, the work of that day being doubled.]


###### Genesis 2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:4)


אֵ֣לֶּה תוֹלְד֧וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ בְּהִבָּֽרְאָ֑ם בְּי֗וֹם עֲשׂ֛וֹת יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶ֥רֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
This is the history of the heavens and the earth when they were created, on the day when Adonoy Elohim made earth and heaven.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
These are the generations of the heaven and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the Lord God made the earth and the heavens.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
These [the above-mentioned] are the engenderings of the heaven and the earth, when they were created, on the day the L-rd G-d made earth and heaven [(whence it is derived that they were all created on the first day (see 1:14)].


###### Genesis 2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:5)


וְכֹ֣ל**׀** שִׂ֣יחַ הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה טֶ֚רֶם יִֽהְיֶ֣ה בָאָ֔רֶץ וְכׇל־עֵ֥שֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה טֶ֣רֶם יִצְמָ֑ח כִּי֩ לֹ֨א הִמְטִ֜יר יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאָדָ֣ם אַ֔יִן לַֽעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
All the plants of the field were not yet on the earth, and all the herbal vegetation of the field had not yet sprouted, for Adonoy Elohim had not brought rain upon the earth, and there was [yet] no man to work the soil.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And no plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet grown: for the Lord God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And every plant of the field was not yet in the earth, and every grass of the field had not yet sprouted [above the ground (the third-day sprouting (12) remaining beneath the surface)], for the L-rd G-d [(the first, Yod-Key-Vav-Key, being His name; the second, Elokim, connoting Ruler and Judge)] had not yet caused it to rain upon the earth, for there was no man to work the ground [and to appreciate the rain, until Adam was created, who recognized that rain was needed for the world, prayed for it, and "secured" it].


###### Genesis 2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:6)


וְאֵ֖ד יַֽעֲלֶ֣ה מִן־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהִשְׁקָ֖ה אֶֽת־כׇּל־פְּנֵ֥י הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
A mist rose up from the earth, and it watered the entire surface of the soil.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And [for the creation of man (1:27)] a vapor rose from the earth and watered the entire face of the ground, [water, as it were, being added to the "dough" for the "kneading" of man].


###### Genesis 2:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:7)


וַיִּ֩יצֶר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֗ם עָפָר֙ מִן־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וַיִּפַּ֥ח בְּאַפָּ֖יו נִשְׁמַ֣ת חַיִּ֑ים וַיְהִ֥י הָֽאָדָ֖ם לְנֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Adonoy Elohim then formed the man, dust from the ground, and He blew into his nostrils the breath of life. And so man became a living soul.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the L-rd G-d formed (vayitzer) [two yods for two "formings," one for this world, one for the resurrection (as opposed to the creation of the beasts (19), where only one yod is written)] the man, dust from the [four corners of the] earth. And He blew into his nostrils a soul of life, and man became a vital soul, [having speech and understanding (as opposed to the beasts)].


###### Genesis 2:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:8)


וַיִּטַּ֞ע יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים גַּן־בְּעֵ֖דֶן מִקֶּ֑דֶם וַיָּ֣שֶׂם שָׁ֔ם אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָצָֽר׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Adonoy Elohim planted a garden in Eden, to the east, and there He placed the man He had formed.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the Lord God planted a garden eastward in ῾Eden; and there He put the man whom He had formed.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the L-rd G-d planted a garden in Eden from the east, and He placed there the man that He had formed.


###### Genesis 2:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/2:9)


וַיַּצְמַ֞ח יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ מִן־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה כׇּל־עֵ֛ץ נֶחְמָ֥ד לְמַרְאֶ֖ה וְט֣וֹב לְמַאֲכָ֑ל וְעֵ֤ץ הַֽחַיִּים֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַגָּ֔ן וְעֵ֕ץ הַדַּ֖עַת ט֥וֹב וָרָֽע׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**

###### Genesis 16:1

Avram’s wife Sarai had not borne him children. She had an Egyptian handmaid whose name was Hagar.

Now Saray Avram’s wife bore him no children: and she had a Miżrian handmaid, whose name was Hagar.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Genesis 16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/16:2)

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Sarai said to Avram: Behold, the L-rd has held me back from bearing. Come, I pray you, to my handmaid. Perhaps I will be built up through her [in the merit of bringing my rival into my house]. And Avram heeded the voice [the Holy spirit] of Sarai.

## Chapter 42

###### Genesis 42:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/42:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/42:1)

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Jacob saw that there was a grain sale in Egypt. And Jacob said to his sons: Why should you be looked upon [strangely by others for not stocking up before your food gives out]?


###### Genesis 42:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/42:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/42:2)


וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּ֣ה שָׁמַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֥י יֶשׁ־שֶׁ֖בֶר בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם רְדוּ־שָׁ֙מָּה֙ וְשִׁבְרוּ־לָ֣נוּ מִשָּׁ֔ם וְנִחְיֶ֖ה וְלֹ֥א נָמֽוּת׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Miżrayim: go down there, and buy for us from there, that we may live, and not die.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he said: Behold, I have heard that there is a (grain) sale in Egypt. Go down (redu) there [(the gematria of "redu" is 210, intimating the years of servitude in Egypt)], and buy grain for us from there so that we live and not die.


###### Genesis 42:3

וַיֵּרְד֥וּ אֲחֵֽי־יוֹסֵ֖ף עֲשָׂרָ֑ה לִשְׁבֹּ֥ר בָּ֖ר מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Genesis 42:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/42:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Genesis/r/42:4)
